How you read the numbers

One naming rule turns your own tracking into a scorecard

  • One naming rule on every link, every flyer, every rep.
  • The asset id rides inside the tag, so you see which cut sold.
  • Conversions API verified firing before the first dollar of spend.
  • TikTok Shop gets its own row. Nobody double counts it.
  • Nine numbers per asset, from hook rate to cost per new customer.
  • One page a month. Keep it, retire it, or reshoot it.

No borrowed benchmarks. Your first 30 days set the baseline.

Every line clears this

Ten checks on every hook, every cut, every caption

  • No disease. Nothing treats, cures, prevents, or heals anything.
  • No promises. Nothing guaranteed, effortless, or on a timeline.
  • No bodies. No weight loss, no muscle gain, no before and after.
  • No FDA. Registered is not approved, and we never blur the two.
  • No shame. We never tell the viewer something is wrong with them.
  • Adults only. Everyone on camera is 18 plus and targeting matches.
  • Real people. Every testimonial is a real person saying a true thing.
  • Paid gets said. Sponsored talent is disclosed up front, on screen.
  • Claims carry receipts. Any performance line ships with its dose and study.
  • Safe lanes win. Doses, labels, COAs, taste, routine, showing up together.

One of the safest things you can film in this category.
